headline: A 2007 executive order by President George W. Bush aimed at improving how well federal government programs perform.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how federal agencies track and improve the results of their programs. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, offices, or deadlines it set up cannot be described here with confidence.

who_it_affects.how: The order appears to direct agencies to focus on measuring and improving how well their programs work.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 13, 2007; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
